question: How do full-utterance, centred two-second, and growing-prefix teacher targets affect the same delayed causal TCN?

full_utterance.window: whole clip; one posterior repeated over all frames

centred_2s.window: [target frame end - 1000 ms, target frame end + 1000 ms]
centred_2s.anchor_expansion: causal previous-anchor hold on the 10 ms grid

prefix_delta250.anchor_expansion: causal previous-anchor hold on the 10 ms grid

policy.margin_classes: source versus target (matches main hi/en policy)

validation.completion_note: All three arms were atomically saved before an unbounded remote snapshot recheck was interrupted; teacher artifact and input hashes were then revalidated directly from local bytes.
